note: AIM-K1 basic usage knowledge. 120 tips SOURCE-VERIFIED against app.html Beta v15.54.0, blob 7ef2e8d17081354e66fc6138ae9cc8a639b839d9. Tips-only pack; no application code is changed.

tips.title: Start your project
q: how do i start my project
what does the green flag do
how can i run my code
tips.text: Press the green Start button at the top. It runs scripts that begin with the green-flag hat.

tips.title: Pause or resume
q: how do i pause my game
how do i make it play again
what does pause do
tips.text: Press Pause to pause the running project. Press it again to resume.

tips.title: Stop the project
q: how do i stop everything
what does the stop button do
how can i stop my game
tips.text: Press Stop at the top to stop all running scripts.

tips.title: Use a starter block
q: why does my script not start
what block goes at the top
how do i start code with a key
tips.text: A script needs a hat block at the top, such as when green flag clicked. Put the blocks you want to run under it.

tips.title: Start code with a key
q: how do i start code with space
how can arrow keys start a script
where is the key pressed block
tips.text: Use the Events block when key pressed, then choose a key from its menu. Put the actions below it.

tips.title: Wait for a moment
q: how do i wait one second
how can i pause one script
what does wait do
tips.text: The Control wait block pauses that script for the number of seconds you enter, then it continues.

tips.title: Repeat a set number
q: how do i repeat something ten times
when does repeat finish
what happens after repeat
tips.text: Repeat runs the blocks inside it the number of times you choose, then continues below the loop.

tips.title: Keep repeating forever
q: how do i keep moving forever
when does forever stop
why does code below forever not run
tips.text: Forever keeps running the blocks inside it until the project is stopped. Blocks below it in that same stack do not run.

tips.title: Use an if block
q: how do i make code happen only sometimes
what does if then mean
how do i check a condition
tips.text: Put blocks inside an if block to run them only when its condition is true.

tips.title: Choose between two paths
q: how do i make two different outcomes
what is if else
how do i do one thing or another
tips.text: Use if then else when you want one set of blocks for true and another set for false.

tips.title: Undo a change
q: how do i undo something
what is the shortcut for undo
can i get my last change back
tips.text: Choose More, then Undo, or use Ctrl+Z, to go back one editing step.

tips.title: Redo a change
q: how do i redo
what is the redo shortcut
i pressed undo by mistake what now
tips.text: Choose More, then Redo, or use Ctrl+Y, to bring back a change you just undid.

tips.title: See your sprites
q: where are my sprites
how do i select a sprite
how do i work on another character
tips.text: The Your sprites area shows the sprites in your project. Select one to work on its code, costumes, and sounds.

tips.title: Open Add Sprite
q: how do i add a character
where is add sprite
what choices are in add sprite
tips.text: Press Add Sprite to open choices for adding a sprite: Upload Sprite, Surprise, Paint, or Plain sprite.

tips.title: Upload a sprite picture
q: how do i add my own picture
can i upload a character
where do i upload an image
tips.text: Choose Add Sprite, then Upload Sprite. Pick a picture file your browser can open.

tips.title: Make a surprise sprite
q: what does surprise sprite do
can g warp pick a sprite for me
how do i add a random sprite
tips.text: Choose Add Sprite, then Surprise to add a randomly coloured sprite at a random spot near the middle.

tips.title: Paint a new sprite
q: how do i draw a new sprite
how do i make a blank character
where is paint sprite
tips.text: Choose Add Sprite, then Paint. G-Warp makes a blank costume and opens the Costumes tab so you can draw.

tips.title: Choose from G-Warp's sprite library
q: where is the sprite library
can i pick a ready made sprite
are these pictures editable
tips.text: The Choose a Sprite library has G-Warp-made pictures you can add. They are editable costumes, not Scratch library art.

tips.title: Rename a sprite
q: how do i rename my sprite
where do i change a sprite name
can i give my character a new name
tips.text: Select the sprite, then edit the Sprite name field in its properties. The sprite list updates with the new name.

tips.title: Move a sprite with X and Y
q: how do i set my sprite position
what are x and y
how do i move it to the middle
tips.text: Select a sprite and change its X or Y property to move it to a precise spot.

tips.title: Change sprite size
q: how do i make a sprite bigger
where do i change size
how do i shrink my character
tips.text: Select a sprite and change its Size property to make it larger or smaller.

tips.title: Duplicate a sprite
q: how do i copy my sprite
can i make a second copy
does duplicate copy scripts too
tips.text: Use the sprite tile's Duplicate option to copy a sprite, including its costumes, sounds, and scripts.

tips.title: Delete and restore a sprite
q: how do i delete a sprite
can i restore a deleted sprite
where is delete sprite
tips.text: Use the delete control on a sprite tile or its menu. G-Warp shows a Restore message after deletion.

tips.title: Keep one sprite in the project
q: why cannot i delete my last sprite
how do i remove the only sprite
what if i need a different sprite
tips.text: G-Warp will not delete the last real sprite. Add another sprite first if you need to remove the current one.

tips.title: Use the Stage blocks
q: where are the stage blocks
how do i change the backdrop with code
what is the stage category
tips.text: The Stage category has blocks for changing the backdrop and reading the backdrop number or name.

tips.title: Switch to a backdrop
q: how do i choose a backdrop
how can i change the scene
where is switch backdrop
tips.text: Use switch backdrop to and choose the backdrop you want from the menu.

tips.title: Go to the next backdrop
q: how do i go to the next scene
what does next backdrop do
how can i cycle backgrounds
tips.text: Use next backdrop to move to the next backdrop in the Stage's list.

tips.title: Move with Motion blocks
q: what are motion blocks for
how do i move a sprite
where are turn blocks
tips.text: Motion blocks move, turn, point, and change a sprite's X or Y position. Try move 10 steps to see the sprite travel.

tips.title: Turn a sprite
q: how do i rotate a sprite
what does turn 15 degrees mean
how do i spin the character
tips.text: Use the clockwise or counterclockwise turn blocks to rotate a sprite by the number of degrees you enter.

tips.title: Set X or Y exactly
q: how do i set x to zero
what is change y by
how do coordinates work
tips.text: Use set X or set Y to place a sprite at a coordinate. Change X or change Y moves it by an amount instead.

tips.title: Point in a direction
q: how do i point my sprite right
what does direction 90 mean
how do i aim a character
tips.text: Use point in direction to aim the sprite. The number is an angle in degrees.

tips.title: Bounce at the edge
q: how do i bounce off the edge
how do i keep my sprite on screen
what does bounce do
tips.text: Put if on edge, bounce in a moving script to make the sprite turn back when it reaches a Stage edge.

tips.title: Use Looks blocks
q: what do looks blocks do
how do i change a costume with code
where is the hide block
tips.text: Looks blocks change what a sprite says, which costume it shows, its size, visibility, and graphic effects.

tips.title: Make a sprite speak
q: how do i make my sprite talk
how do i show a message
how do i make the speech bubble go away
tips.text: Use say for a speech bubble, or say for seconds when you want the bubble to disappear after a time.

tips.title: Make a sprite think
q: how do i make a thought bubble
what is the think block
how can my sprite think
tips.text: Use think to show a thought bubble, or think for seconds to show it for a set time.

tips.title: Switch costumes in a script
q: how do i change costume while playing
how do i cycle costumes
what does next costume do
tips.text: Use switch costume to for a chosen costume, or next costume to move to the next one in the costume list.

tips.title: Show or hide a sprite
q: how do i hide a sprite
how do i make it appear again
does a hidden sprite still run code
tips.text: Use show to make a sprite visible and hide to make it invisible. Scripts can still use a hidden sprite.

tips.title: Change a graphic effect
q: how do i change sprite colour
what is the ghost effect
where are graphic effects
tips.text: Use the Looks effect blocks to set or change an effect such as colour, whirl, brightness, or ghost.

tips.title: Use Sound blocks
q: where are sound blocks
what is play sound until done
how do i stop sounds
tips.text: Sound blocks can play a sound, start one without waiting, stop all sounds, and change the volume.

tips.title: Play a sound and wait
q: how do i play a sound then continue
what does until done mean
how do i make a sound finish first
tips.text: Play sound until done waits for that sound to finish before the next block runs.

tips.title: Start a sound and keep going
q: how do i play a sound without waiting
what is start sound
how do i keep code moving while music plays
tips.text: Start sound begins the sound but lets the script continue to its next block right away.

tips.title: Stop all sounds
q: how do i stop music and effects
where is stop all sounds
how do i silence everything
tips.text: Use stop all sounds when you want every sound to stop.

tips.title: Change project volume
q: how do i make sound quieter
how do i set volume to 50
where is the volume block
tips.text: Use set volume to choose a level, or change volume by to move it up or down.

tips.title: Start an event when a sprite is clicked
q: how do i run code when i click my sprite
what is when this sprite clicked
how do i make a click event
tips.text: Use when this sprite clicked to run a script after that sprite is clicked.

tips.title: Send a message to sprites
q: how do sprites talk to each other
how do i send a message
what is broadcast
tips.text: Use broadcast to send a named message. Other sprites can use when I receive to react to it.

tips.title: Wait for message scripts
q: what is broadcast and wait
how do i wait for another sprite
what is the difference from broadcast
tips.text: Broadcast and wait sends a message, then waits for the matching receiver scripts to finish before continuing.

tips.title: Start a clone script
q: how do i start code on a clone
what is when i start as a clone
how can each clone do something
tips.text: Use when I start as a clone for the script that each new clone should run.

tips.title: Start code when the backdrop changes
q: how do i run code after a scene changes
what is when backdrop switches to
how do i react to a new backdrop
tips.text: Use when backdrop switches to and choose a backdrop to run a script when that backdrop appears.

tips.title: Repeat until a condition is true
q: how do i repeat until i touch something
what is repeat until
when will this loop stop
tips.text: Repeat until keeps running its inner blocks until the condition becomes true.

tips.title: Check a key
q: how do i check if space is down
what is key pressed
how do i make a key condition
tips.text: Use key pressed? to check a key inside an if block or another condition.

tips.title: Check whether things touch
q: how do i check if two sprites touch
what is touching edge
how do i detect a collision
tips.text: Use a touching block to check the pointer, an edge, or another sprite.

tips.title: Read the mouse position
q: how do i read mouse position
what is mouse x
how do i make something follow the mouse
tips.text: Use mouse x or mouse y to read the pointer's position on the Stage.

tips.title: Ask a question and use the answer
q: how do i ask a question in my game
where does the answer go
how do i use what someone types
tips.text: Ask and wait shows a question. The answer reporter gives you the words the user typed.

tips.title: Use the timer
q: how do i use the timer block
how do i reset the timer
how can i count seconds
tips.text: Use timer to read elapsed time, and reset timer when you want to start counting from zero.

tips.title: Do maths with Operators
q: where are the maths blocks
how do i add two numbers
how do i compare numbers
tips.text: Operators include addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, comparisons, and other number tools.

tips.title: Join words together
q: how do i join two words
how do i make a sentence
what does join do
tips.text: Use join to put two pieces of text together into one message.

tips.title: Count letters in text
q: how do i count letters in a word
what does length do
how can i find the word size
tips.text: Use length of to find how many characters are in a piece of text.

tips.title: Pick a random number
q: how do i make a random number
what does pick random do
how do i choose a random score
tips.text: Use pick random to choose a number between the two numbers you enter.

tips.title: Make a variable
q: how do i make a score
where is make a variable
how do i add points
tips.text: Choose Make a Variable in Variables, give it a name such as score, then use set or change to update it.

tips.title: Set a variable's starting value
q: how do i reset my score
how do i set a variable to zero
where should i set my score
tips.text: Use set variable near the start of your game, such as setting score to 0.

tips.title: Add to or take from a variable
q: how do i add one point
how do i take away a life
what does change variable do
tips.text: Use change variable by to add or subtract from its current value. A negative number takes value away.

tips.title: Show a variable on Stage
q: how do i show my score
where did my variable go
how can i hide a score display
tips.text: Use show variable to display its monitor on the Stage. A checkbox beside a variable can also show or hide its monitor.

tips.title: Choose who can use a variable
q: what does for this sprite only mean
how do i share a score with every sprite
which variable choice should i pick
tips.text: When you make a variable, choose For all sprites or For this sprite only. The second choice keeps it with that sprite.

tips.title: Make a list
q: how do i make a list
where is make a list
can a list belong to one sprite
tips.text: Choose Make a List in Lists, name it, and choose whether it belongs to all sprites or just this sprite.

tips.title: Add an item to a list
q: how do i add something to my list
what does add to list do
how do i save an answer in a list
tips.text: Use add item to list to put a new value at the end of the list.

tips.title: Remove an item from a list
q: how do i delete one list item
how do i remove the second item
what does delete item do
tips.text: Use delete item of list to remove the item at the position you choose. Check the item number first.

tips.title: Show or hide a list
q: how do i show my list on stage
how do i hide a list
where did my list display go
tips.text: Use show list or hide list to choose whether the list display appears on the Stage.

tips.title: Make your own block
q: what are my blocks
how do i make my own block
what does define mean
tips.text: The My Blocks area has define and call custom blocks. A custom block lets you group steps under a name you choose.

tips.title: Call a custom block
q: how do i use my custom block
what does call custom do
how do i run a block i made
tips.text: Use call custom with the same block name to run the steps in that custom block.

tips.title: Use parameters in a custom block
q: what are custom block inputs
how do arguments work
why is the order important
tips.text: The My Blocks palette shows comma-separated parameter names and arguments. Use the same order when calling the block.

tips.title: Make a clone
q: how do i make clones
what block creates a clone
where do i put clone code
tips.text: Use create clone of myself to make a copy while the project runs. Put clone behaviour under when I start as a clone.

tips.title: Delete a clone when it is done
q: how do i delete a clone
how do i stop too many raindrops
when should a clone delete itself
tips.text: Use delete this clone when a clone has finished its job, such as reaching the bottom of the Stage.

tips.title: Keep clone numbers under control
q: how many clones can i have
why did my clones stop appearing
how do i keep clones under control
tips.text: G-Warp uses a 300-clone default limit. Delete clones when they are no longer needed to help avoid reaching the limit.

tips.title: Open the Costumes tab
q: where do i edit a costume
how do i open costumes
how do i change my sprite picture
tips.text: Choose Costumes in the main tabs to work on the selected sprite's pictures.

tips.title: Use the Brush tool
q: how do i draw on my costume
where is the brush
how do i paint my sprite
tips.text: In the simple paint panel, choose Brush, then draw on the canvas. The drawing is synced to the selected costume.

tips.title: Use the Eraser tool
q: how do i erase part of my drawing
where is the eraser
how do i fix a paint mistake
tips.text: Choose Eraser, then draw over the parts you want to remove from the costume canvas.

tips.title: Choose paint colour and size
q: how do i change brush colour
how do i make the brush smaller
where is the paint size slider
tips.text: Use the colour picker to choose a colour and the size slider to make your brush thicker or thinner.

tips.title: Clear the paint canvas
q: how do i clear my costume drawing
what does clear do
can i undo after clear
tips.text: Press Clear in the simple paint panel to clear the canvas. This removes the drawing from the selected costume.

tips.title: Choose a costume in the list
q: where are my costumes listed
how do i choose a costume
how do i edit a different costume
tips.text: The costume sidebar lists the selected sprite's costumes. Choose one there to work on that costume.

tips.title: Open the Sounds tab
q: where do i edit a sound
how do i open sounds
where are my sprite sounds
tips.text: Choose Sounds in the main tabs to work with sounds for the selected sprite.

tips.title: Upload a sound
q: how do i add my own sound
what sound files can i upload
where is sound upload
tips.text: In Sound Studio, use Upload and choose an audio file such as MP3, WAV, or OGG.

tips.title: Record a sound
q: how do i record a sound
where is the microphone button
how long can a recording be
tips.text: Use Record in Sound Studio to record with your microphone. Recording is up to 15 seconds when recording is available in your browser.

tips.title: Preview a sound
q: how do i listen to my sound
where is sound preview
can i hear it before using it
tips.text: Choose a sound and press Play in its sound editor to listen before using it in a script.

tips.title: Use sound effects
q: how do i change pitch
what is pan in sound
where are sound effects
tips.text: The Sound Studio has buttons such as Faster, Slower, Louder, Softer, Fade in, Fade out, Reverse, Echo, and Robot. Try one, then press Play to hear the change.

tips.title: Open Song maker
q: where is song maker
how do i make music in g warp
where are song styles
tips.text: In Sounds, open Song maker to build a song with parts, styles, moods, and themes.

tips.title: Choose a song style
q: how do i change music style
where is the genre menu
how do i make a different kind of song
tips.text: Use the Song maker style menu to choose the kind of music you want to hear.

tips.title: Choose a song mood and theme
q: how do i make the song happier
where is the mood menu
how do i choose a song theme
tips.text: Use the mood and theme menus in Song maker to change the feeling and subject of the song.

tips.title: Generate a song
q: how do i make a song
what does generate do
how do i create new music
tips.text: Press Generate in Song maker after choosing the settings you want. G-Warp creates the song parts for those choices.

tips.title: Play and stop a song
q: how do i listen to my song
how do i stop the song
where are play and stop
tips.text: Use Play to hear the Song maker output and Stop to end playback.

tips.title: Use Mix, Classic, or Fresh
q: what are mix classic and fresh
how do i choose a tune
where is my melody choice
tips.text: The Song maker has Mix, Classic, and Fresh tune choices. My melody is available after you make a melody in the instrument area.

tips.title: Open Create Melody
q: where is create melody
how do i write my own tune
how do i make a two bar melody
tips.text: In Sounds, find the instrument area and open Create Melody to write a two-bar tune on the note grid.

tips.title: Start a melody from an idea
q: how do i start a melody
where are the melody ideas
can i change a starter tune
tips.text: In Create Melody, use Start from to pick one of the eight starter melody ideas. Then change squares to make it yours.

tips.title: Add or remove a melody note
q: how do i add a note
how do i remove a note
what do the melody squares do
tips.text: Tap a square in the Create Melody grid to add a note there. Tap that same note again to remove it.

tips.title: Play your melody
q: how do i hear my melody
where is play in create melody
which instrument plays my tune
tips.text: Press Play in Create Melody to hear your tune with the instrument you selected above.

tips.title: Change melody speed
q: how do i make my melody faster
where is melody speed
what are the speed choices
tips.text: Choose Slow, Normal, or Fast in the Create Melody speed menu.

tips.title: Save and use your melody
q: how do i save my tune
how do i put my tune in a song
where are saved melodies
tips.text: Press Save melody to keep it. Press Use in Song maker, then choose My melody in Song maker to play it in your song.

tips.title: Open Animation
q: where is animation
how do i animate my character
is animation only for developer mode
tips.text: Open Animation from the costume tools to work with a rigged character and its frames. Animation is available to everyone.

tips.title: Rig a vector character
q: what kind of costume can i rig
how do i add bones
why does my bitmap not rig
tips.text: The rigging tool works with vector costumes. Make a vector character first, then add bones and joints to it.

tips.title: Pose a character with bones
q: how do i move a bone
how do joints work
how do i pose my character
tips.text: In Animate mode, drag a red bone end to turn it around its joint. The bones after it follow.

tips.title: Move the whole rig
q: how do i move the whole character
what is the orange base
how do i reposition a pose
tips.text: Drag the orange base joint to move the whole figure to a new place in the frame.

tips.title: Add animation frames
q: how do i add a frame
where is the frame strip
how do i make another pose
tips.text: Use the frame strip at the bottom to add or copy frames for different poses.

tips.title: Turn on onion skin
q: what is onion skin
how do i see the last pose
where is onion skin
tips.text: Turn on Onion skin to see the previous frame while you pose the current one.

tips.title: Preview and loop an animation
q: how do i preview my animation
how do i loop my animation
how do i stop the preview
tips.text: Press Play to preview frames. Turn on Loop to go from the last frame back to the first.

tips.title: Make animation frames into costumes
q: what does make costumes do
how do i use my frames as costumes
can i export the animation
tips.text: Press Make costumes to turn each animation frame into a normal vector costume in order.

tips.title: Save your project
q: how do i save my project
where is save
does save update the file i opened
tips.text: Open More, then the File options, and choose Save. When the browser allows it, Save writes back to the file you opened.

tips.title: Save a separate copy
q: how do i save a copy
where is save as
how do i keep two versions
tips.text: Open More, then the File options, and choose Save as to save a separate project file.

tips.title: Load from your computer
q: how do i open my project file
where is load from computer
how do i open a saved project
tips.text: Open More, then choose Load from your computer and select a project file.

tips.title: Load from the web
q: how do i load a project from the web
can i open a Scratch project link
where is load from web
tips.text: Open More, then choose Load from the web to open a project using a supported Scratch project link or number.

tips.title: Restore an earlier version
q: how do i get an older version back
where are restore points
can i undo a save
tips.text: Open More, then choose Restore a previous version to look through the saved restore points in this browser.

tips.title: Know the .sb3 file type
q: what file type does g warp save
can i open my project in Scratch
where are g warp extras stored
tips.text: G-Warp saves projects as .sb3 files. G-Warp-only extras are kept in hidden project data so they do not appear as Scratch blocks.

tips.title: Open the Extensions library
q: where is extensions
how do i open extension library
where can i find extra blocks
tips.text: Choose Extensions at the bottom of the category rail to open the extension library.

tips.title: Read extension safety labels
q: how do i know if an extension is safe
what does dangerous mean
where are extension warnings
tips.text: The extension library shows safety levels such as Safe, Moderate, or Dangerous. Read the warning before loading an extension.

tips.title: Use Calm motion
q: how do i turn off moving effects
where is calm motion
what does calm motion change
tips.text: Open More, then Settings, and switch Calm motion on if you want fewer animations. It is off by default.

tips.title: Keep G-Warp's own look
q: how do i change block appearance
where is look like scratch
does this change how blocks work
tips.text: The Look like Scratch option changes the block appearance. It is off by default, so G-Warp keeps its own electric style.

tips.title: Snap blocks together
q: how do i connect blocks
why does the snap line appear
how do i stack blocks
tips.text: Drag a block close to a compatible connector in the workspace. G-Warp shows a snap preview to help place it.

tips.title: Use the block right-click menu
q: how do i copy a block
where is delete full stack
what does right click do
tips.text: Right-click a block in the workspace to see Duplicate, Delete Block, and Delete Full Stack.

tips.title: Find a block in your scripts
q: how do i search my code
what does ctrl f do
how do i find the next block
tips.text: In the code area, Ctrl+F opens Find in scripts when that add-on is on. Press Enter to jump to the next match.

tips.title: Name your project
q: where do i rename my project
what is the title field
how do i name my game
tips.text: Edit the project title field at the top of G-Warp to give your project a name.

tips.title: Confirm before a dangerous extension
q: what if an extension says dangerous
can i cancel loading it
who should i ask first
tips.text: A dangerous extension shows a warning and asks you to confirm. You can choose Don’t load it; kids should ask a parent first.

tips.title: Start a script when the Stage is clicked
q: how do i start code when stage is clicked
is stage click different from sprite click
where is that event
tips.text: Use when stage clicked in Events when you want a script to start after the Stage is clicked.
